summary_text: Rockwell Automation (NYSE: ROK) achieved a Q2 FY26 beat on both EPS and revenue, with margin expansion and higher volumes driving the upside, supporting the raised outlook. Reported Q2 adjusted EPS of $3.30 and raised FY26 adjusted EPS view to $12.50-$13.10. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 18th will be paid a dividend of $1.38 per share ($5.52 annualized, ~1.3% yield). Truist Financial Corp reduced its stake in Rockwell Automation by 24.5% during Q4 per 13F filing.
